# pbs_metric_servers (Data Source)

Lists the metric servers of a Proxmox Backup Server — the InfluxDB servers it sends its metrics to, over HTTP or UDP — with their settings, but without tokens, which PBS never returns. Needs `Sys.Audit on /`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_metric_servers" "all" {}

# Where PBS sends its metrics, by name: the URL of an HTTP server, the
# host:port of a UDP one.
output "metric_targets" {
  value = {
    for s in data.pbs_metric_servers.all.servers : s.name => coalesce(s.url, s.host) if s.enable
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) The metric servers of both types, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) InfluxDB bucket; `proxmox` when the server sets none. Null for a UDP server.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether PBS sends its metrics to the server.
- `host` (String) Address of the UDP listener, `<host>:<port>`. Null for an HTTP server.
- `max_body_size` (Number) Most bytes of metrics PBS sends in one request. Null for a UDP server.
- `mtu` (Number) Largest datagram PBS sends, in bytes. Null for an HTTP server.
- `name` (String) Metric server name.
- `organization` (String) InfluxDB organization; `proxmox` when the server sets none. Null for a UDP server.
- `type` (String) Type of the server: `influxdb-http` (`pbs_metric_server_influxdb_http`) or `influxdb-udp` (`pbs_metric_server_influxdb_udp`).
- `url` (String) Base URL of the InfluxDB server. Null for a UDP server.
- `verify_tls` (Boolean) Whether PBS verifies the TLS certificate of an `https://` URL. Null for a UDP server.
